messages:
alex: ops-bot alerted at ~10:42 but several pages never reached oncall. seeing a suppression spike in the logs for that window. anyone else noticing?

ops-bot: [ALERT] suppressor-matcher fired (rule: quiet-hours-v2) for 3 events. matched_count=3 severity=high 

meera: yep saw it. i got one delayed page ~10:44 after manual trigger. was oncall at the time — customers reported delayed notifications.

ryan: do we have any signing failures or 403s in the webhook logs? previous issues were signing/key rotation related.

alex: pulled logs from notify-proxy: 
```
2026-03-18T10:42:11Z notify-proxy ERROR webhook verify failed: signature mismatch header:x-signed  response=403
2026-03-18T10:42:12Z suppressor INFO matched rule=quiet-hours-v2 reason=channel-tagged
```

meera: hmm signature mismatch + suppressor triggered. could be two independent things or suppressor matched a template because webhook metadata was truncated.

oncall-sam: i didn't get paged until 10:46 when alex manually escalated. customer impact: two customers reported delayed incident alerts, no downtime but delayed ops reaction.

ryan: can someone check the signing key rotation logs? maybe the signing service rolled a key at 10:40 and some integrations still post with old key.

alex: checking key-rotator svc: 
```
2026-03-18T10:40:03Z key-rotator INFO rolled signing-key id=rot-2026-03-18-10:40
2026-03-18T10:40:05Z key-rotator WARN pending propagation to notify-proxy=45s
```

ops-bot: suppressor: rule quiet-hours-v2 applied to channel #oncall-east because message.metadata.tags contains "maintenance". action=hold until 2026-03-18T11:00:00Z

meera: i just forced a suppressor override for the window and manually paged again: `/pager send --team oncall-east --urgent "manual escalate: test after override"` — oncall-sam confirmed receipt. :white_check_mark:

alex: thanks — sounds like manual mitigation worked. can we also replay the three webhooks that were dropped so we can audit customer payloads?

ryan: i'll run a replay but we need to be careful — preserving ordering. creating a short script to requeue to safe-queue.

alex: rn the short term mitigation steps i propose: 1) keep suppressor override on until suppressor rule is patched to check header length and signing validity, 2) add an alert for signing-verify-failures rate > 5/min, 3) add telemetry linking suppressor matches to signature-verify failures.

meera: i'm going to patch the suppressor rule to require metadata.tags includes "planned-maintenance" instead of any "maintenance" substring. will push a canary change to staging then to prod.

oncall-sam: one thing to add — update playbook: when signing-verify-failures spike, auto-break suppressor for 5m and notify #eng-oncall. saved 2-3 minutes of manual work in this incident.

ryan: replay queued webhooks to safe-queue now. i'll post progress.

ops-bot: [ACTION] suppressor override enabled by meera (expires 2026-03-18T11:30:00Z)

alex: thanks team. for postmortem: owner=ryan, timeline capture=alex, customer-impact writeup=meera. follow-ups: key-rotator fanout SLAs, suppressor rule rework, new alert for signature failures.

meera: pinging security for key propagation audit and onboarding on-call to rotation runbook.

ryan: replay complete — 3 webhooks requeued to safe-queue, no payload corruption. will start draft postmortem later today.

alex: closing ops loop for now. will keep this thread for updates until PM completes the postmortem. :memo:
